slug: 2024-07-25 Africa Data Centres adding 6MW capacity in Cape Town

facts.fact: Africa Data Centres (Cassava Technologies) operates its CPT1 colocation data centre in Cape Town at 5.5MW, plus two data centres in Johannesburg; a 6MW expansion to 11.5MW was announced; as_of is the article date as no opening date is given.

note: The expansion itself is not a separate fact.
